title: Hailey Collet · quartic boundary
method: The exact boundary is 11/12−ℓ/4, where ℓ is the unique root in [1/6,1/5] of 927ℓ⁴−3135ℓ³+2433ℓ²+275ℓ−100=0. The plotted rational 683505193/781250000 is a proved upper bound less than 4×10⁻¹⁴ above it. The proof extends the unconditional common-mesh moving-radical moment and applies weighted low/high estimates and analytic continuation to Dirichlet, zeta and finite-order Eisenstein Hecke L-functions.
verification_note: The 3,224 Lean modules were rebuilt in an offline Linux sandbox. Comparator verified the rational and exact quartic all-Dirichlet, zeta and Eisenstein Hecke bounds, quartic root existence and uniqueness, and the reusable moment theorem. Lean, NanoDa and con-ron accepted all eight targets. The timeline records this first independent acceptance.
